decisions.title: Educational content remains AI-generated
decisions.summary: The bot validates and renders model output; it does not replace educational generation with hard-coded lessons.

decisions.title: GitHub Issues are the canonical issue registry
decisions.summary: Issues live natively on GitHub Issues with labels for category, priority, and phase. project_status.json remains canonical for phase/decision tracking. The dashboard is a generated view.

decisions.title: Compact JSON is an internal provider optimization
decisions.summary: Wire-format compactness must not change the canonical card schema or learner-facing content richness.

decisions.title: Default card detail and premium expansion
decisions.summary: The current roadmap keeps detailed as the global default; minimal cards with a premium More details action remain a product proposal until explicitly approved.

decisions.title: Language metadata lives only in catalog.py
decisions.summary: New languages and language-specific guidance are added through catalog.py rather than duplicated in prompts, config, keyboards, or bot handlers.

decisions.title: Learner reminders should be friendly and progress-aware
decisions.summary: Reminder copy can reference streak, remaining cards, and due reviews to encourage interaction, but cadence and scoring remain separate from the wording.

decisions.title: Review navigation belongs in a dedicated core review hub
decisions.summary: Review cards, previous/next navigation, and translation reveal are core UX flows and should remain available to all users through same-message edits when possible.

decisions.title: Advanced goal options are language-aware and premium-gated
decisions.summary: The core goal list stays simple for everyone; richer language-scoped goals are added as an eligible premium layer using the canonical catalog.

decisions.title: Extra gamification beyond streak is premium-only
decisions.summary: Points, badges, or similar reward surfaces remain separate from streak and retention, and should be introduced only as an explicit premium feature.

decisions.title: Bot.py extraction via staged modules
decisions.summary: Completed 5-stage extraction (2026-07-18/19) plus final package restructuring (2026-07-20): flat modules moved to config/, handlers/, services/ packages. All imports rewritten to absolute style. AGENTS.md responsibilities table updated. Each stage independently verified with full test suite.

decisions.title: TTS pronunciation via Edge TTS, premium-gated
decisions.summary: Edge TTS (free) integrated for vocabulary card pronunciation. Premium-only (Silver/Gold), on-demand button (🔊 تلفظ), filesystem caching, send_voice(). tts.py module with no provider abstraction.
